source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex-limited and sex-influenced traits (PDF 110-111).

blocks.text: Kuch khasiyatein sex-linked nahi kyunke un ke alleles sex chromosomes par nahi, phir bhi nar aur maada mein mukhtalif nisbat mein hoti hain. Aisi khasiyaton ki do qismein hain.

Sex-limited khasiyaton ke genes dono jinson mein hote hain lekin jismani banawat ya hormones ke farq ki wajah se sirf aik mein zahir hote hain. Nar aur maada bhed dono mein seengon ki nashonuma ke genes hain lekin sirf nar mein zahir hote hain; doodh banane ke genes nar aur maada mammals dono mein hain lekin sirf maada mein zahir hote hain; aur insanon mein daarhi ugne ke genes sirf mardon mein zahir hote hain. Isi tarah prostate cancer ke genes sirf mardon mein aur ovarian cancer ke sirf auraton mein zahir hote hain, halanke dono jinson mein maujood hain.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Sex-limited genes jinsi farq (sexual dimorphism) ke zimmedar hain: aik hi species ke nar aur maada ke phenotype mein farq.

Sex-influenced khasiyaton mein aik hi gene har jins mein mukhtalif tareeqe se zahir hota hai: alleles aik jins mein dominant aur doosri mein recessive hote hain, hormones ke farq ki wajah se. Insanon mein jism ke baalon ki miqdar aur ganj-pan sex-influenced hain. Ganj-pan ka allele mardon mein dominant lekin auraton mein recessive hai.

blocks.caption: Ganj-pan sex-influenced khasiyat (B ganj-pan ka allele)

blocks.title: Alamaat par note
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke mard BB ya Bb ho to ganja, aur aurat sirf 'jab do recessive alleles (bb) virasat mein le'. Agar B ganj-pan ka allele hai, jo kitab ke mutabiq auraton mein recessive hai, to aurat ko ganji hone ke liye ganj-pan ke do alleles, yaani BB, chahiye; chhapa hua 'bb' isi tarah parha gaya hai aur table isi par hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat: aaj ki genetics
blocks.text: Genetics ab amli science hai: DNA sequencing aur genetic engineering tehqeeq karne walon ko genes badalne dete hain; mukammal Human Genome Project ne bimariyon aur khasiyaton ki genetic bunyad ki samajh barhayi hai; aur genetics doctors ko mareezon ki genetic profile ke mutabiq tashkhees aur ilaaj mein madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Sex-limited aur sex-influenced khasiyat mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Sex-limited khasiyat sirf aik jins mein zahir hoti hai (mendhon mein seeng, maada mein doodh). Sex-influenced dono jinson mein ho sakti hai lekin us ka allele aik mein dominant aur doosri mein recessive hai (ganj-pan).

items: Dono qismein sex-linked nahi: genes autosomes par hain.
Sex-limited: sirf aik jins mein zahir (seeng, doodh, daarhi).
Sex-influenced: aik jins mein dominant, doosri mein recessive (ganj-pan).
